LESSON: RESPONDING TO

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Responding to

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Responding to. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: when asked instructions a) respond confidently to questions and to pronunciation and accuracy with to do something?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. ask questions to seek clarity on  Learners play language games involving instructions responding to instructions and
2. demonstrate willingness to answer answering questions(songs, games questions and follow instructions following a particular pattern) in pairs and groups
